[Act: special-marriage
 Chapter: Miscellaneous
 Section: 45::Penalty for signing false declaration or certificate.
]


Every person making, signing or attesting any declaration or certificate required by or under this Act containing a statement which is false and which he either knows or believes to be false or does not believe to be true shall be guilty of the offence described in section 199 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (45 of 1860).

metadata.section_title: Penalty for signing false declaration or certificate.
